reviews.comment: Worst professor I had avoid him at all costs. If u can take the class with another professor.
This prof purged the MSEN infidels who coasted thru all the ez classes in the major

Radovic is extremely over-hated; this class he was pretty good. Admittedly the lectures can be kinda long but some of the content is pretty interesting. The tests are really hard, but if you do all of the homework you'll be relatively fine. He moved back tests to give us more time to study, and he gives a lot of extra credit with quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No homework, random quizzes every few weeks with very hard multistep questions. Grading is very inconsistent on quizzes and tests, and if he messes up on the test, but you wrote it in penci,l you're screwed. Very weird grading criteria with no curve even when majority of the class is failing.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures get very boring very fast, but most of the homework can be done using the book. Pop quizzes are extra credit, but his exams are really bad.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Time wasting of taking his class
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Hilarious--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Coming to class is not mandatory, although he reads pretty much verbatim off the slides, and there are optional pop quizzes at the end of the class. Exam 1 started very difficult, subsequent exams were easier. At first neither him nor his TA were responsive but that oddly seemed to change throughout the semester. Make of this what you want.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Recommend taking this class with another professor if possible. Professor reads off slides and give some real life application, lectures feel chill and fun. However, tests are difficult, failed exam even after spent whole weekend reviewing homework, lecture slides, quizzes, and mock exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy

reviews.comment: This man is the worst. Reads verbatim off the slides, don't even bother coming to class. I have no idea what's going on. Tests are extremely difficult, average in the 50s, no curves. And both him and his TA are extremely rude and irresponsive when asked questions. AVOID at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have had to deal with. The class did not translate well into an online format and seemed to exacerbate previous issues noted in other ratings. If you do have to take him, take meticulous notes over slides as quiz questions are extremely specific. Take note of ANY deviations from the lab manual when doing lab and make observations.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Probably the worse prof I've had at A&M. Takes YEARS to grade labs, when he does he doesn't make it clear how you lost points or how to improve. There's typos on literally everything he gives to you and report requirements are never clear. His quizzes also aren't great as he asks very slide specific questions. Wish I didn't have to take his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Radovic's takes an extremely long time to grade and gives vague instructions for assignments. Then, once graded, he doesn't clearly show where points were taken off or how to fix it. His quizzes can also be difficult, but if you go back through all the notes and study anything that seems "quiz worthy", you might not fail.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst Materials prof I've had so far. Vague expectations for lab reports, and takes off points for the most random reasons, making feedback frustrating and unhelpful. Lecture typos and misinforming the students lead to rants later blaming us. Too many textbooks to read, just go to class and take notes like your life depends on it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take him. Be prepared to have an extra class (if he is absent for lecture). He will assigned about 3 books to read and will make you feel dumb. He takes about 2 months to grade a lab report & does not give instructions of his expectations for reports. Lab B is due this week and still waiting on Lab A report grade ( turned in a month ago)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm currently in MSEN 301 with Radovic and it's frustrating. The class material is pretty interesting and the labs are great, but Dr. Radovic makes this class a pain. He does not set clear expectations for assignments and any information that students need is uncentralized and difficult to find.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Radovic is rude and expects the worst of students. The last day of class is in about a week and my first lab report has not been graded. This has resulted in myself and other students blundering through this course due to gross lack of instruction. The class seems to be designed to be inconvenient. Logistics issues are blamed on the students.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Absolutely got shreked by Dr. Radovic. You can tell he's smart, but he uses that smartness for makeup classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His lectures match what are on exams. His explanations are decent and he'll answer questions if you ask them. It isn't a particularly hard class, but you actually need to take the time to study the slides and textbook on your own. He graded fair, and exams weren't too bad. It's a very straightforward class. Better than some other materials profs
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is not very accessible outside of class. It is extremely obvious that he does not care too much about the class and does nothing to make the class interesting. The material is not hard but since he puts no effort into teaching his class the tests are hard. I learned more from the book in 3 days than 3 weeks of going to lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class was not difficult, the professor was difficult. I struggled because Dr. Radovic's abrasive personality seriously inhibited my learning ability. This was the first class I had to drop and it was completely due to his stubborn and mean personality.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Radovic is very busy, so he'll probably miss class (and that means make-up classes at night). The exams sometimes get pushed back, which means all your grades are in the last two weeks. He does not put time into this class (especially not the exams), so typos and vague language are everywhere. This class isn't useful and is very difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Reads directly from slides during lecture and test content is not covered in class. Only four tests are given, all are free response with a 50 min time limit. They cover a lot information so it is very difficult to study and determine what material is actually going to be tested. If you have to take him, it helps to go talk to him in office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Miladin does not teach well, and he does not like answering questions. He also talks really quietly and has an accent so it's hard to understand him. He gives four exams and that's it, which means that your grade is based solely on how you do on the tests... 10/10 do not recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is terrible. He loves to smile but he just reads directly off the slides. His lectures are really boring and the only grades in the class are the 4 tests plus a final.
